hypothesis: Recent aggressor-side trade notional across complementary Up/Down tokens contains directional information: Up buys and Down sells support Up, while Up sells and Down buys support Down.

selection_contract.normalization: absolute directional notional difference divided by total complementary-token trade notional
allowed_inputs: unique PMXT trade prints deduplicated by transaction hash
trade side, price, and size on both complementary tokens
latest causal Up/Down best bid and ask only for fixed execution bounds
forbidden_inputs: BTC path, displacement, strike distance, or volatility
external model probability or model edge

outcome_free_grid_rationale.evidence_read_before_preregistration: feature-store coverage and trade-count/absolute-imbalance distributions only; labels were not read
outcome_free_grid_rationale.minimum_trade_prints_basis: 25, 75, and 150 span the observed causal trade-count distribution and leave multiple rules above the fixed older/recent support floors; the original 1, 2, and 4 candidates were outcome-free but non-discriminating

integrity_correction: The initially recorded derived hash 54ecfcc512cddf8363ade4976fa29453f8344639d0a9e7bbbdffafcc6f252feb hashed jq pretty JSON. It was mechanically corrected to the compact serde_json hash above. No policy field, threshold, gate, input, or budget changed.

cheap_screen.older_gate: positive point edge above top-quote fee-aware break-even
cheap_screen.recent_gate: point edge above 0.02 and positive top-quote fee-aware payoff proxy

fresh_holdout_policy: Fresh outcomes remain physically unavailable unless a frozen exact-replay trace clears the advancement gate.
terminal_rule: After at most two unique exact replays, advance once to the fresh gate or reject the family. Positive point PnL cannot authorize more hours, variants, or replay traces.
